Herrmann and Kross; IMSLP work pages for parts and publishers; DNB catalogue (d-nb.info, SRU) for modern prints; Internet Archive scans; RCM Violin Syllabus 2021 text (etude lists) for syllabus placements; Shar/Schott retailer pages for Hofmann Op. 96. Not reachable or not bypassed: Hofmeister XIX (TLS error), IMSLP forum thread on Hohmann (bot check), HathiTrust (403), UdK Berlin repository (bot wall). No score PDFs were opened, so contents and levels of the many obscure books are estimates (confidence 'low' = existence from a list/IMSLP page, level from title only). Brief's guesses corrected: Sitt Op. 20/21/40/49/71 are not study books (only Op. 32, 41, 69, 92, 98 and the later opp. 80, 134, 135 are); Kayser Op. 42 does not appear in any source; Wohlfahrt Op. 38 is the beginner 'Easiest Elementary Method' (below floor) - 'Foundation Studies for the Violin' (Carl Fischer) is a compilation of first-position studies from Op. 45/54/74, not Op. 38. Floor decisions: Sitt Op. 32 Book 1 and Wohlfahrt Op. 54 are first-position books included because RCM 2021 puts their etudes at Levels 4-5 (= catalogue L1, same logic as the Wohlfahrt Op. 45 anchor); the other first-position-only books are in 'skipped'.
